_comment: Photon counting histogram tool. Drawn by emtk.view_form over PchModel (gui/model.py); the two plots are hand-drawn in gui/app.py.

buttons.label: Load TTTR
buttons.description: Choose a photon-stream file (PTU, HT3, T2R, T3R, PTO, SPC) to analyse.

buttons.label: Compute PCH
buttons.description: Bin the photons of the loaded file into counting intervals and histogram the counts per bin.

buttons.label: Fit Model
buttons.description: Fit the species model (brightness and occupancy per component) to the histogram over the selected k range.

buttons.label: Save Results
buttons.description: Write the histogram, the fit and the results text as NPZ, CSV and TXT files.

sections.label: File
sections.description: The photon-stream file that is loaded. Use Load TTTR or drop a file on the window.

sections.label: Channels
sections.description: Comma-separated routing channels whose photons are counted, for example 0,2. Empty uses all channels.

sections.label: Bin time
sections.description: Width of the counting interval in microseconds. The histogram is the distribution of photon counts per interval.

sections.label: Micro time
sections.description: Lower micro-time gate (TAC channel): photons below it are not counted.

sections.label: to
sections.description: Upper micro-time gate (TAC channel): photons above it are not counted.

sections.label: Components
sections.description: Number of molecular species in the model. Each species has a brightness ε and a mean occupancy ⟨N⟩.

columns.label: ε
columns.description: Molecular brightness: counts per bin per molecule. Starting value for the fit; replaced by the fitted value. Double click to edit.

columns.label: ⟨N⟩
columns.description: Mean number of molecules of this species in the detection volume. Starting value for the fit; replaced by the fitted value. Double click to edit.
